articles.title: US, EU and 30 countries warn of famine risk in Sudan, call for aid

events.summary: The US, EU, and 30 other countries issued a joint warning regarding famine risk in Sudan and demanded humanitarian access. They urged warring factions to remove barriers impeding relief supplies.
events.why: Highlights an acute, large-scale humanitarian crisis threatening millions with starvation.

articles.title: Sixty Christians killed in Ethiopia’s Oromia region

events.summary: Church officials reported that sixty Christians were killed and more than 20 injured during flare-ups in Ethiopia's Oromia region. In addition, 20 homes were burned down amid rising religious tensions.
events.why: Significant sectarian violence with high loss of life and property destruction in an unstable region.

articles.title: Drone strike kills at least 21 and injures 40 in Sudan’s Nyala

events.summary: A drone strike on a market in northern Nyala city in Darfur, Sudan, killed at least 21 people and injured 40. The strike occurred on a Monday evening according to a local resident.
events.why: Represents a deadly civilian mass casualty event in the ongoing Sudan conflict.

articles.title: Israelis begin voting as Netanyahu fights for political survival

events.summary: Israelis have begun voting in national elections with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu facing Gadi Eisenkot. The election occurs amidst sharp divisions over conflicts in Gaza and Iran.
events.why: The governance of Israel directly impacts regional conflict dynamics, diplomacy, and global stability.

articles.title: Palestine weekly: West Bank under siege as Israelis go to the polls

events.summary: Israel sealed off the West Bank and emptied sections of Hebron as its national election campaign concluded. Authorities also intensified restrictions on the Gaza Strip.
events.why: Imposes broad movement restrictions and security pressures affecting millions of Palestinians.

articles.title: South Korea’s GDP growth beats forecasts amid AI boom

events.summary: South Korea's economy grew 3.4 percent year-on-year, outperforming forecasts. The growth was driven primarily by robust demand for semiconductors amid the artificial intelligence boom.
events.why: Reflects critical macroeconomic and supply chain health in a key global tech and chip-exporting hub.
